errors.busy: An export of this project is being built. Wait until it is finished.
errors.notReady: The export is not ready to download.
errors.expired: The download period of this export is over and its file was deleted. Create a new export.
errors.fullExportAdminOnly: This export was made by a system administrator and holds the whole project: only a system administrator can download or delete it.
errors.importAdminOnly: Only a system administrator can restore a project: it creates a new project.
errors.noFile: Choose the export package (ZIP) to restore.
errors.fileTooLarge: The package is larger than the upload limit of this installation.
errors.codeRequired: Enter a project code for the restored project.

import.notZip: The file is not a readable ZIP package: {{detail}}
import.tooManyEntries: The package has more than {{max}} entries.
import.unsafePath: The package contains an unsafe entry name: {{name}}
import.duplicateEntry: The package contains the entry {{name}} twice.
import.missingEntry: The package is incomplete: {{name}} is missing.
import.unlistedEntry: The package contains {{name}}, which its checksum list does not name.
import.partTooLarge: The part {{name}} is too large to read.
import.badJson: The part {{name}} is not valid JSON.
import.badSums: The checksum list (SHA256SUMS) of the package is not valid or does not agree with manifest.json.
import.checksumMismatch: Checksum mismatch: {{name}} was changed or damaged after the export. Nothing was restored.
import.wrongSchema: This is not a SiteKeep project export of a known version ({{schema}}; expected {{expected}}).
import.uploadGone: The uploaded package is no longer available. Upload it again.
import.fileWithoutFolder: {{name}}: its folder is not in the package; the file was left out.
import.hashDiffers: {{path}}: the bytes differ from the SHA-256 recorded at upload in the source (already reported by the export); restored as they are.
import.transitionsOff: The source project enforced the ISO 19650 state transitions. The transition table is not part of the package: set it up in Project Settings → CDE, then turn enforcement on again.

notifications.exportReadyBody: {{files}} files ({{versions}} versions) and {{issues}} issues. Download it from Project Settings → Export.
notifications.importReadyBody: The project {{code}} was restored. People without an account here: {{unknown}}.

readme.title: SiteKeep full project export
readme.scopeFull: Scope: the whole project (exported by a system administrator).
readme.scopeVisible: Scope: what the person who exported it can see (folder permissions and the task team WIP rule).
readme.purpose: The package holds the project's information in open formats (JSON, CSV, BCF 3.0) so that it can be restored into another SiteKeep installation or read by another CDE. Format: {{schema}}, described in docs/features/PROJECT_EXPORT.md of SiteKeep.
readme.manifest: schema version, project, counts, the list of parts and the checksum of every entry
readme.folders: folder tree with CDE states and folder permissions
readme.filesJson: every file with all its versions: document code, codes, state, SHA-256, approvals
readme.files: the bytes of every version in the folder structure (older versions as "name (V2).ext")
readme.members: members, companies, roles and task teams
readme.reviews: reviews, workflow steps and every reviewer's mark
readme.transmittals: transmittals with their files, events and receipts
readme.audit: the project's audit log (without IP addresses and user agents)
readme.check: Check the package: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS (macOS: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS).
